title: West Metro, Espoo and Tampere connect operating assets with municipal services
summary: One operating metro project and two municipalities distinguish station energy results, regional wastewater, future budgets and service access. Eligibility reaches 93 projects and 64 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Seventeen official English, Finnish and Swedish HTML bodies or scoped segments inspected November 22. Opening, budget approval, reported savings, planned work and service eligibility remain distinct; Helsinki's existing identity is retained without recounting.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
